title: Consultant for Homeowner Housing Rehabilitation
short_description: Consulting services to administer Passaic's homeowner housing rehabilitation program.
project_scope: Professional consulting support for the City of Passaic's Homeowner Housing Rehabilitation Program, funded through the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) program of the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development. The consultant will provide technical assistance to the Department of Community Development on an as-needed basis and help implement all required program activities for homeowner housing rehabilitation. No building size, number of units, or technical structural parameters are stated.
services: Program administration and technical assistance for homeowner housing rehabilitation; support to the Department of Community Development; rehabilitation and refurbishment-related consulting on an as-needed basis.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a program administration and housing rehabilitation consulting assignment.
- No specific structural design, bridge, roof, special structure, or complex building engineering scope is described.
- Includes urban development/program implementation rather than engineering design services.
- Does not match sbp's target focus on bridges, long-span structures, special structures, or architecturally demanding buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice describes an as-needed consultant contract for administering a housing rehabilitation program funded by CDBG, but provides no number of homes, rehabilitation volume, or capital works budget, so no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee or contract value is stated in the source. The assignment is an as-needed 12-month consulting contract for program administration and technical assistance, without sufficient scope detail for a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Professional consultant to assist with administering the Homeowner Housing Rehabilitation Program and provide technical assistance to the Department of Community Development on an as-needed basis. No specific minimum references or qualification thresholds are stated in the source excerpt.
